title: Fachberater/in Milchvieh
description:
Bei Claudius Wurth Agrarberatung bieten wir maßgeschneiderte Beratungslösungen für landwirtschaftliche Betriebe an, die sich auf betriebswirtschaftliche Fragen spezialisiert haben. Unser Team unterstützt Landwirte bei wichtigen Entscheidungen wie Hofübergaben, der Erstellung professioneller Gutachten und der Neuausrichtung landwirtschaftlicher Betriebe. Als Unternehmensberater/in für den Bereich Milchvieh spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle dabei, unsere Klienten bei der Optimierung ihrer Milchviehbetriebe zu unterstützen. Sie beraten zu Themen wie Direktvermarktung und neuen Stallkonzepten und tragen so zur nachhaltigen Weiterentwicklung unserer Kunden bei. Bei uns erwartet Sie ein dynamisches Umfeld mit vielfältigen Herausforderungen, in dem Sie Ihre Expertise einbringen und weiterentwickeln können. Werden Sie Teil eines engagierten Teams, das landwirtschaftliche Betriebe in eine erfolgreiche Zukunft begleitet.
Aufgaben

Beratung von Milchviehbetrieben zu betriebswirtschaftlichen Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.
Erstellung von individuellen Konzepten zur Neuausrichtung und Weiterentwicklung von Milchviehbetrieben.
Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Hofübergaben und Nachfolgeregelungen.
Durchführung von Marktanalysen und Erstellung professioneller Gutachten zur Verbesserung der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit.
Beratung beim Einstieg in die Direktvermarktung und bei der Planung neuer Stallbauten.

Qualifikation

Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Agrarwissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Beratung von landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben, idealerweise im Bereich Milchviehhaltung.
Fundierte Kenntnisse in betriebswirtschaftlichen Analysen und Gutachtenerstellung.
Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln.

title: Autodesk Inventor Specialist
description:
Role Title: Autodesk Inventor Specialist
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Autodesk Inventor Specialists to contribute to a customer-focused project involving advanced mechanical design. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Develop fully-parametric 3D CAD models of mechanical parts and assemblies based on detailed written briefs using Autodesk Inventor (or comparable platforms).

• Edit and update existing models to reflect revised requirements, ensuring all changes remain fully parametric and in line with best practices.

• Audit and review CAD models for compliance with dimensional, tolerance, and manufacturability criteria, identifying and documenting any gaps or issues.

• Create and interpret detailed technical drawings, applying ASME Y14.5 or equivalent GD&T standards.

• Ensure robust Design for Manufacturability (DFM) considerations across processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, CNC machining, and casting/forging.

• Support AI training initiatives by providing clear documentation and rationale for design decisions, edits, and audits.

• Communicate effectively in written and verbal formats, delivering precise feedback and solution-oriented insights to project stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Minimum 4 years of hands-on parametric modeling experience for edit-level tasks; 10+ years for complex creation work.

• Expertise in Autodesk Inventor, with fluency in similar platforms like FreeCAD, SolidWorks, or Fusion 360 considered highly relevant.

• Demonstrated proficiency with GD&T (ASME Y14.5 or equivalent), with practical, real-world application.

• Proven DFM experience covering at least two to three manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, sheet metal, CNC, casting).

• Experience with reverse engineering workflows, such as scan-to-CAD or point cloud-to-model reconstruction.

• Ability to manage assembly-level designs and complex mechanical systems, not just single-part modeling.

• Familiarity with CAD automation, scripting (Python, iLogic, VBA, NX Open), or similar tools for enhancing workflow efficiency.

The group will focus on one of the most important and interesting challenges in software today: determining how to help customers discover and purchase your product in the age of AI and Agents, for headless and UI-based use cases, and with credits as an emerging pricing model.

About the Role

The traditional PLG monetization model was built for a world of static, tier-based upgrades accessed through a point-and-click UI. We are moving toward agent-based, credit-priced products distributed across multiple surfaces - including APIs and LLM interfaces - and our buying strategy must evolve to match. 

As a Staff Product Manager for Monetization and Product Led Growth, you will own the evolution of this buying experience. This will include two charters:

• Being the single person who can oversee the entire end-to-end buying journey across various prospect and customer touchpoints

• Rebuilding our monetization infrastructure from static upgrade prompts in HubSpot’s UI, to agentically delivered, just-in-time, contextual upgrade moments delivered both in-app and via LLM interfaces. We will define and build the capabilities to recommend and sell the right product to the right customer at the right time, agnostic of whether they are using HubSpot in our app or via MCP. 

What You Will Do

• You will own the buying, product discovery, and upgrade experience across HubSpot. You will be the single Product Manager accountable for how customers move from our freemium funnel to the solutions that best meet their needs.

• You will define HubSpot’s Product Led Monetization strategy for the AI era. This includes evolving from static upgrade triggers to personalized, context aware upgrade moments powered by large language models and delivered through conversational assistants and MCP. You will help define what an upgrade moment looks like and means when users don’t have a traditional UI to interact with and monetization becomes more usage-based.

• You will partner with product teams across HubSpot to align buying patterns and create a coherent, consistent customer experience across the platform.

• You will work closely with go to market teams on pricing launches, upgrade campaigns, and customer communication strategies related to driving monetization.

• You will present strategies, progress, and results to senior leaders, including members of the executive team.

What We Are Looking For

• You have owned monetization or the buying experience for a software as a service product. This is a core area of expertise for you.

• You have worked on a product with credit based, usage based, or outcome based pricing. You understand how these models affect both how a product is built and how it is sold.

• You have driven alignment across multiple product groups without relying on direct authority. You know how to influence decisions, build commitment, and move teams toward a shared outcome.

• You have meaningful AI product experience. You have worked on or alongside products built around artificial intelligence, and you understand how large language models are changing product strategy, customer expectations, and business models.

• You bring strong business model fluency. You can think strategically about pricing, packaging, monetization, and go to market motions, not only feature roadmaps.

• You have worked in both a scaled organization and a more entrepreneurial environment. You can navigate the complexity of a large company while remaining comfortable building something new from the ground up.

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $400M ARR, growing from $10M/yr 12 months ago. We’re the world’s fastest growing AI doctor.

- Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

- Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2031: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

- Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS https://app.notion.com/p/Working-at-AIOS-5b5c0a584af44de78ac7fb9b2cf8d993?pvs=21

Your ownership continues in production. You’ll follow how people use what you built, understand the relevant metrics, identify where the experience falls short, and keep improving it.

title: Security Risk Management Specialist II
description:

About the Team

Affirm values security as being critical to the company's continued success. The Security Risk Management team is evolving beyond traditional governance, risk, and compliance; we are building an engineering driven program that designs, automates, and scales the controls, workflows, and tooling that protect Affirm and our customers.

About the Role

The ideal candidate will evaluate, build, and refine solutions to third-party risk and security governance challenges across the Security Third Party Program and the broader Security Risk Management program. They are equally comfortable applying security policy to real-world vendor decisions and shipping automation using modern tooling (Python, Cursor, Claude, and other agentic coding platforms) to replace manual GRC work with scalable, code-defined workflows. They will develop deep expertise across the security risk domain, partner closely with business and engineering stakeholders, and play an active role in Affirm's transformation of Security Risk Management from a compliance-oriented function into a security engineering discipline.

What You'll Do

We are looking for a curious, collaborative Security Risk Management Specialist to help scale Affirm's Third Party Risk Management program through process rigor, hands-on automation, and strong cross-functional partnership.

• You will conduct third-party security assessments, reviewing vendor questionnaires, evaluating security controls, and documenting risk findings as a core contributor to Affirm's TPRM program.

• You will build and maintain automation to reduce manual GRC workflows, using Python, low-code platforms, and agentic coding tools to improve program efficiency and scale.

description:
Telemedi to jedna z najszybciej rosnących firm telemedycznych w Europie Środkowo-Wschodniej. Budujemy platformę B2B, z której korzystają ubezpieczyciele, banki i pracodawcy. Działamy na styku trzech bardzo regulowanych światów: ochrony zdrowia, ubezpieczeń i technologii - a to znaczy, że prawo jest u nas nie kosztem, tylko częścią produktu.
Szukamy osoby na początku drogi zawodowej, która chce nauczyć się rzemiosła prawniczego w wymagającym środowisku i traktuje AI jako naturalne narzędzie pracy - tak jak nasz zespół IT programuje z AI, tak dążymy by wszystkie pozostałe działy potrafiły z nim współpracować.
Requirements
Czego szukamy
To nie jest ogłoszenie o „przeklikiwanie umów". Szukamy określonego sposobu myślenia i postępowania (umiejętności technicznych i dopasowania do zasad, które cenimy w organizacji).
Krytyczne myślenie i łączenie kropek. Potrafisz wziąć przepis, kontrakt, decyzję organu i pismo drugiej strony - i zobaczyć, jak to się ze sobą łączy. Nie zatrzymujesz się na tym, „co jest napisane", tylko pytasz „co z tego wynika" i „jaka jest za tym logika; gdzie jest ryzyko, którego nikt nie nazwał". Wątpliwość traktujesz jako sygnał do drążenia, nie jako problem do pominięcia.
Sprawność proceduralna. Rozumiesz, że prawo to nie tylko treść, ale i tryb: terminy, właściwość organu, forma, kolejność kroków, droga odwoławcza.
AI jako narzędzie myślenia, nie wyręczania się. Używasz LLM-ów do tego, w czym są dobre: szybkiego przeczesania dużej ilości materiału, analizy danych, sprawdzania własnego rozumowania „pod światło". Ale wiesz, gdzie AI się myli, weryfikujesz każde źródło i bierzesz pełną odpowiedzialność za wynik. AI ma czynić Cię szybszym i bardziej wnikliwym - nie zastępować Twojego osądu.
Analiza danych. Nie boisz się arkusza, zestawienia, rejestru. Potrafisz z danych - wykazu postępowań, historii decyzji, parametrów umów - wyciągnąć wzorzec i przełożyć go na argument prawny lub rekomendację.
Zakres obowiązków
Wejdziesz w szerokie spektrum spraw obejmujących codzienne funkcjonowanie firmy:

• Analiza i przygotowywanie umów oraz dokumentów kontraktowych (B2B, dostawcy, partnerzy)

• Research prawny i przygotowywanie analiz oraz notatek na potrzeby biznesu

• Wsparcie w obszarze compliance i ochrony danych osobowych

• Udział w prowadzeniu postępowań oraz przygotowanie pism i korespondencji z organami

• Monitorowanie zmian w przepisach istotnych dla działalności firmy

• Budowanie i doskonalenie wewnętrznych narzędzi i workflowów wspieranych AI dla obsługi prawnej

Czego oczekujemy

• Wykształcenie prawnicze (ukończone studia lub ostatnie lata)

• Bardzo dobra umiejętność analizy tekstu i logicznego, ustrukturyzowanego myślenia

• Skrupulatność i odpowiedzialność za szczegół

• Naturalna ciekawość wobec AI i chęć włączenia jej do codziennej pracy

• Bardzo dobra polszczyzna w mowie i piśmie, dobra znajomość angielskiego

• Proaktywność i samodzielność w szukaniu odpowiedzi

Mile widziane

• Pierwsze doświadczenie (praktyki, staż) w kancelarii lub dziale prawnym

• Zainteresowanie prawem medycznym, farmaceutycznym, ochroną danych lub regulacjami sektora ubezpieczeń

• Doświadczenie w pracy z narzędziami AI wykraczające poza podstawowe użycie

Co oferujemy

•
Wynagrodzenie: 7 000-14 000 PLN (B2B lub umowa zlecenie)

• Praca z Warszawy lub w pełni zdalnie

• Realny wpływ na to, jak obsługa prawna firmy korzysta z AI

• Środowisko, w którym prawo dotyka prawdziwego produktu i realnych decyzji biznesowych

• Szerokie spektrum spraw - nie zaszufladkujesz się w jednej wąskiej dziedzinie

Benefits

Nasze wartości

• Organizational "YES": Witamy osoby, które z entuzjazmem podchodzą do zmian i nowych możliwości.

• 5x why, first principles: Zachęcamy do zadawania pytań "dlaczego?" i szukania lepszych rozwiązań.

• Data-driven: Wspieramy decyzje rzetelnymi danymi i analizami. Zawsze weryfikujemy informacje u źródła -nie przyjmujemy założeń bez sprawdzenia faktów i danych.

Engineers own specific blocks inside a larger subsystem, working alongside the principal engineers and architects who set its direction. A block stays with the engineer who wrote it through PPA closure, tapeout, and bring-up, so you debug your own design in silicon.

• Support post-silicon bring-up and debug for the blocks you own.

• Contribute to design flow improvements, including AI and automation in EDA tool methodologies.

• Solid foundation in computer architecture and digital logic design.

description:

Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. We measure fetal, tumor, or donor cfDNA at the molecular level to help inform personalized health care decisions with a non-invasive test. The Natera R&D Department is looking for a highly motivated Staff Scientist to join the rapidly growing  assay development team to help build the future of Natera. In this position, you will be an integral part of high-performing teams across functions to develop laboratory tests that positively impact the business and our patients. A successful candidate will have a deep understanding of molecular biology, strong scientific curiosity and high level of expertise of developing cfDNA assays through product development cycles. • Collaborate closely with research scientists, automation engineers, biostatisticians and data scientists within a dynamic R&D team to develop new and innovative molecular assays.

• May manage Scientists or Research Associates.

• Experience in managing projects and direct reports.

• Must possess very strong interpersonal, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

• Long-read sequencing technologies (e.g., PacBio).

description:

Location: Tokyo, Japan

Databricksは、お客様がAIプラットフォームを活用して、世界で最も難しいなデータに関する課題を解決できるよう支援することをミッションとしています。デリバリーソリューションアーキテクト（DSA）は、この重要なミッションにおいて、セールスおよびフィールド・エンジニアリングチームと協力し、お客様のDatabricksプラットフォームの導入と利用拡大を加速させる重要な役割を担います。DSAとして、お客様がすでに導入を決定したDatabricksのワークロードについて、お客様がプラットフォームから最大限の価値と投資対効果を得られるよう、技術的な指導とサポートを提供し、お客様の成功を確実にします。特に、複雑な課題を抱えるお客様に対して、より重点的かつ技術的な責任を持って支援を行います。
このポジションは、技術とビジネスの両面を兼ね備えたハイブリッドな役割です。担当するお客様とユースケースにおいて、成長を推進します。ビジネス面では、お客様の意思決定者と関係を構築し、他の専門チームと連携しながら、Databricksが実行できる計画や戦略を策定・推進します。技術面ではDatabricksの全製品における、お客様導入後の技術的なリーダーとなります。組織内のあらゆるレベルの人々と、技術的な専門知識を活かしてコミュニケーションをとる能力が求められます。本ポジションは、日本のフィールド・エンジニアリング・ディレクター/Technical GM の直属となります。

あなたがもたらす影響 : 

• ソリューション・アーキテクトと連携し、重要顧客におけるユースケースの全体的な需要計画を把握します。

• Databricksの主要なユースケースにおいて、Technical Win後のアカウント戦略と実行計画を主導します。

• 複数の営業チームや社内関係者と連携し、特定のユースケースや顧客に対する技術的な責任者となります。お客様がDatabricksの導入を決定したワークロードについて、不確実性を取り除き、オンボーディング、有効化、成功、本稼働、そして健全な利用を推進します。

• お客様が合意したユースケースの本番稼働や運用に関する技術的な問題や質問に対し、最初の窓口として対応します。特に、大規模で複雑な組織においては、複数のユースケースを担当することが多くあります。

• 社内の専門家（共有サービス、ユーザー教育、オンボーディング／技術サービス、サポートなど）と連携し、自身の業務範囲や専門知識を超えるタスクを適切に割り振ります。必要に応じて、より専門的な技術エキスパートにもエスカレーションを行います。

• 主要なユースケースを本番環境へ迅速に移行させるための視点を構築し、プロフェッショナルサービスと連携して提案書の作成を進めます。

• Databricksの製品・エンジニアリングチームと連携し、新製品のイノベーション、プライベートプレビュー、アップグレードのニーズに対応します。

• 本番環境へ移行する主要なユースケース

• 有効化／ユーザー成長計画

• エグゼクティブおよび運用ガバナンス

• 利用状況や顧客の状態に関するKPIレポート（投資状況、重要なリスク、製品導入、ユースケースの進捗状況など）を、Technical GMに定期的に報告します。

必要な条件/経験:

• データおよびAI領域における技術的なプロジェクト/プログラムのデリバリーに責任を持ち、顧客との技術的な議論や設計の選択に貢献した8年以上の経験。

• 分散データシステムに関連するソリューション・アーキテクチャの理解。

• 特定のプロジェクト成果物に対し、ビジネス価値と成果を結びつける方法の理解。

• アカウント、ステークホルダー、リソース管理の責任を含む技術的なプログラムまたはプロジェクト管理の経験。

• 顧客企業のシニア・エグゼクティブとの間で、複雑かつ重要なエスカレーションを解決した経験。

title: Software Engineer, Data, AI & UX
description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified - giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship .

About the Role

As a member of the Data team, you will build the services, infrastructure, and data platforms that power our business. Our team is responsible for ingesting, processing, storing, and distributing large volumes of data reliably and efficiently, enabling teams across the business to make data-driven decisions and build innovative products. 

This role sits at the intersection of backend software engineering and data engineering. You will develop scalable backend services, design and maintain data pipelines, and build the underlying data infrastructure that enables reliable, cost-effective, and high-performance data processing. 

You'll work closely with other engineering teams, data consumers, and infrastructure specialists to build robust solutions that balance technical excellence with delivering business value. While the role involves technical collaboration across the organization, it is primarily focused on engineering rather than stakeholder management. 

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving complex technical problems, takes ownership of their work, and can make pragmatic engineering decisions that maximize impact. 

This will be a full-time role, owning the following responsibilities :

• Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and APIs in Python that support data ingestion, processing, and distribution.

• Building and maintaining reliable data ingestion pipelines for structured and unstructured data from a wide variety of internal and external sources.

Our Channel is exploding and we are expanding the team! •

Requirements

description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar
Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.
Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal, reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões.
Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.
Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.
Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: https://grupoquintoandar.com/

Atuamos no modelo  remote-first , oferecendo total flexibilidade para você trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil. Para quem gosta de encontros presenciais, disponibilizamos nosso escritório em São Paulo e coworkings parceiros. Além disso, contamos com o programa Work From Anywhere (WFA), que permite trabalhar remotamente de qualquer lugar do mundo por até 90 dias no ano.

O time de Pós-Venda B2B do Grupo QuintoAndar é responsável por impulsionar o sucesso e a retenção de imobiliárias parceiras que utilizam nossa solução de Inteligência Artificial Conversacional (Domi). Em uma fase de forte aceleração e escala, atuamos desde a integração inicial até a garantia diária de engajamento e resolução de problemas técnicos de contas de pequeno, médio e grande porte. Somos a voz do cliente dentro de casa e a ponte direta com os times de Produto e Tecnologia para evoluir continuamente nossa plataforma. 

 

Responsabilidades

• Onboarding e Conexão Técnico-Operacional: Conduzir o processo de onboarding de imobiliárias parceiras, garantindo a integração rápida e eficiente do produto de IA com a operação do cliente.

• Engajamento e Sucesso da Base: Acompanhar indicadores de uso do sistema pelas imobiliárias, garantindo o engajamento contínuo e incentivando a adoção de todas as funcionalidades.

Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview
Instacart 's Customer Experience & Operations organization is at the heart of how we support the millions of customers, shoppers, and partners who rely on our platform every day. Within that organization, the CX Technology Programs team is responsible for driving the development and deployment of technology solutions that meaningfully improve the support experience at scale.
We are looking for a CX Technology Program Manager to join a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of automation, operations, and product execution. title: Senior Product Manager (Data APIs)
description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets - the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

THE OPPORTUNITY

 

9fin has built one of the most comprehensive datasets in credit and debt markets: news, financials, cap tables, instrument data, legal documents, and ESG analysis. Today, most clients access that data through 9fin.com http://9fin.com. But a large and growing segment of the market wants to consume our data programmatically to power firm-level workflows at scale: a negative news signal triggers an automated credit review, updated financials trigger a portfolio rebalance, a covenant keyword triggers a sanctions flag.

 

These buyers (quant desks, data engineering teams, systematic investors, risk and compliance functions) will never log into a web application. They need APIs, data feeds, and cloud-native delivery through platforms like Snowflake. At comparable financial data providers, this distribution channel represents 20-30% of total revenue. 9fin is at the beginning of this journey.

 

The challenge is to turn 9fin's integrated dataset into a portfolio of standalone data products with a coherent commercial strategy. You will define how the data gets packaged (what goes together, what stands alone, how it's tiered and priced), the order in which products go to market, and the commercial models that fit each buyer segment: quant desks, data engineering teams, risk and compliance functions, and systematic investors. You will work in lockstep with the Head of Pre-Sales, who owns technical validation and deal execution, to ensure that what you build maps to how these buyers actually evaluate and procure data. The first candidates pan news content, financials and cap tables, instrument data, and legal data (complex, high-value, and genuinely unsolved at the data representation layer).

 

You will work cross-functionally across our platform teams, analytics engineering, and the domain squads that own the underlying datasets. You will also work closely with Sales to support a fundamentally different GTM motion: solution-selling with partner clients, joint POCs, multi-stakeholder deals, and usage-based commercial models rather than seat-based subscriptions.

 

This is a 0-to-1 build. If you have built API or data products before and want to do it again in a market where the opportunity is wide open, this is it.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: vIOP Clinical Quality Supervisor
description:
About Lyra
 
Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced mental health clinician and leader with a passion for clinical care, quality, supervision, and management to serve as a clinical quality supervisor for our Pediatric virtual Intensive Outpatient Program (vIOP), an accelerated, comprehensive care experience that helps young people ages 7 to 25 feel better quickly from the comfort of home. The pediatric vIOP is a critical service for acute patients who need more than traditional, once-a-week therapy. This program is a critical component of our full-spectrum of care services. It not only helps to avoid re-hospitalization, but its availability within our services ensures these members have direct access to our core coaching, therapy, and psychiatry services once they are stabilized. 
As a vIOP Clinical Quality Supervisor you will spend half the time delivering direct client care and half the time providing management oversight and clinical supervision to vIOP Associate Social Worker (ASW) therapists.
Direct client care: You will provide time-limited, evidence-based treatment via telehealth. You’ll conduct individual, family, and group skills training sessions, maintaining a caseload of diverse and varied clinical needs. You’ll conduct psych urgent care individual sessions as needed, which consists of risk and safety assessments and developing stabilization plans. An important note: Clients come from a multitude of different backgrounds and experiences, and have varying needs and abilities. We strive to continue to meet their unique needs by delivering culturally responsive care-an approach that accounts for the impact of cultural backgrounds on each person’s care experience. 
Clinical supervision and management: You will help train, manage, and supervise a team of ASW therapists utilizing CBT, DBT, ERP and other evidence-based practices to support vIOP clients through our innovative video therapy platform. This includes reviewing and providing feedback on clinical quality metrics and consulting on clinical cases. You will also assist with quality improvement initiatives including specialty consultations, provider training, and quality assurance reviews. 
Regularly: Our vIOP team members enjoy connecting with peers, who share a passion for providing evidence-based care. You’ll attend one-on-one clinical consultation, multidisciplinary team meetings, and robust training to enhance your clinical and supervision skills. You’ll always have access to expert consultation and support for your most complex clients. It’s like a safety net of resources to help plan the best options-from specialty consultations to culturally responsive care-you’re not alone, even while working remotely within the US. 
This role is a great fit if you have experience supporting pediatric and young adult clients with mood and anxiety disorders in a high acuity (IOP, PHP, residential) setting using evidence-based and culturally responsive practices, as well as supervising and managing registered ASW’s. 
This role reports to our vIOP Clinical Quality Manager.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

About the role:

The Customer Success Executive - Enterprise role will play a critical part in the exciting growth and retention trajectory of the Enterprise Sector at Okta. You will report to the Regional Manager, Customer Success and be responsible for complementing Okta’s innovations, best practices, and capabilities with our valued customers’ business objectives and priorities. As a strategic and trusted advisor, you will shift customer mindsets, create demand for our solutions, and drive higher business value and executive alignment between Okta and our customers.

The ideal candidate embodies a high-performance mindset-consistently raising the bar, turning action into traction, thriving in change, and moving fast to simplify and repeat. It requires complementing Okta’s innovations, efficiencies and capabilities with our valued customers’ business objectives and priorities thereby driving higher business value and executive alignment between Okta and our customers, but it also demands a leader who can navigate these constraints with urgency and an obsession for concrete outcomes. Strong problem-solving, orchestration, and consultative skills are necessary for navigating challenges, finding innovative solutions, and winning as a team.

In this role, you will: 

• Deliver Customer Value: Develop and nurture strong customer and C-Level relationships to understand their business goals and needs, ensuring retention, happiness, and a significant return on investment. Cement yourself as a trusted and strategic advisor, translating complex technical concepts into actionable business outcomes.

• Drive for results: Design and execute proactive success plans and Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) with clear goals, KPIs, and timelines-turning strategy into measurable traction.

• Win as a team: Champion customers internally and mobilize cross-functional partners across Sales, Support, Engineering, and Product to resolve escalations and lead coordinated success motions.

• Represent the customer's voice: Gather and surface feedback that drives continuous improvement, actively challenging what needs to evolve.

• Guide customers forward: Identify and communicate relevant new products and features, helping customers adopt and benefit from Okta's agentic capabilities.

• Identify renewal risk and collaborate with internal teams to remediate, ensure a successful renewal, and proactively spot expansion opportunities.

You will thrive in this role if you:

• Have 10+ years of experience in a customer success, account management, or consulting role, managing relationships with large, complex enterprises (preferably working with a SaaS-based technical enterprise product).

• Have a solid track record of delivering and scaling an exceptional customer experience, choosing ambition over comfort and consistently raising your own bar.

• Demonstrate strong emotional intelligence and an elite level of relationship management and executive stakeholder development.

• Possess exceptional presentation and communication skills, particularly when engaging with C-level executives to align technical goals with business value.

• Have strong listening and analytical skills with the demonstrated ability to ask effective questions, dive deep, understand the customer’s business priorities, and anticipate their needs. 

• Exhibit strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally to win as a team.

title: KI Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
deine arbeitswelt

Gestalte die Zukunft der Künstlichen Intelligenz - gemeinsam treiben wir digitalen Fortschritt voran.
Wir suchen KI Engineers, die moderne Technologien nutzen, neugierig bleiben und aktiv zur KI-Zukunft beitragen - und so unsere technologische Weiterentwicklung entscheidend mitgestalten.

Du entwickelst AI-Agenten, die unsere Consultants täglich unterstützen, und baust ein Agenten-Ökosystem auf, das Beratung und Implementierung nachhaltig beschleunigt.

Entscheidend ist dein Wille, Neues auszuprobieren, dazuzulernen und moderne KI-Technologien weiterzuentwickeln.

• Du entwickelst produktive KI-Lösungen mit Fokus auf LLMs, Machine Learning und GenAI - von der Idee bis zum Deployment

• Du führst LLM-Fine-Tuning, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) und Aufbau von KI-Agenten-Architekturen durch

• Du entwickelst AI-Architekturen für Cloud-Umgebungen (z.B.Azure)

• Du analysierst Daten,trainierst und evaluierst Machine-Learning-Modelle zur Lösung konkreter Use Cases

• Du erstellst Prototypen, die in Zusammenarbeit mit Software-, Cloud- undDevOps-Teams in stabile skalierbare Lösungen überführt werden

• Du beobachtest den KI-Markt, bewertest neue Tools und leitest sinnvolle Einsatzszenarien ab

• Du bringst KI direkt in Geschäftsprozesse und Produkte ein und arbeitest an realen Use Cases mit spürbarem Impact - von Automatisierung bis Wissensmanagement

was dich auszeichnet
Wir suchen KI Engineers mit echter Lernmotivation und starkem technologischen Interesse - unabhängig davon, ob du im Unternehmen oder außerhalb erste KI-Projekte umgesetzt hast.

Must-haves

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python

• Du bringst fundierte Grundlagen in Machine Learning sowie den sicheren Umgang mit modernen Python-Ökosystemen mit

• Du hast Erfahrung in mindestens einem dieser Schwerpunkte: LLM-Fine-Tuning, RAG, KI-Agenten

• Du kannst Erfahrung mit Vektordatenbanken, relationalen Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenverarbeitung und Prompt Engineering vorweisen

Nice-to-haves

• Du hast Erfahrung mit Frameworks zur Modellintegration (z. B.LangChain, SemanticKernel, Transformer-Frameworks)

• Du verfügst über Kenntnisse in MLOps-Tools wie Docker, Kubernetes oder GitHub Actions

• Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie Google Cloud

• Du hast Erfahrung in mindestens einer weiteren für Azure relevanten Sprache (z. B. C#/.NET oder Type Script) für die Integration von KI-Lösungen, Azure AI Services und LLM-Workflows

das kannst du von uns erwarten

• Eine erfolgreiche, innovative und moderne Management-Beratung im Zentrum von München

• Sehr attraktives und leistungsbezogenes Gehaltspaket, Boni, unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag inkl. 30 Urlaubstage

• 100% Homeoffice mit modernen Office-Möglichkeiten in München und Gütersloh

• Familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten mit flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen und Gleitzeit

• Mobilitätspaket: JobRad, Firmenauto oder Bahnkarte

• Moderne Büroräume mit verkehrsgünstiger Lage und hochwertige Arbeitsmittel

• Flache Hierarchien, Raum für Ideen und kollegiales Miteinander

• Fachliche Weiterentwicklung und individuelle Förderung, wie z.B. bei der Weiterentwicklung der rhetorischen Fähigkeiten oder dem Abschluss einer Microsoft Zertifizierung

• Ein Team, das zusammenhält und Spaß am Teamwork hat

• Wertschätzung von Leistungen: Erfolge werden gefeiert und anerkannt
